description: This file is a C++ source implementation for the DataElement class and related classes in the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes method definitions for CRC calculations, buffer management, and data copying, and references external header 'DataElement.h'.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with CRC calculation capabilities, storing a buffer for data.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A linked list style data element that can manage buffers across linked nodes, with capabilities for buffer retrieval, setting, and copying.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
methods.description: Calculates a CRC32 checksum over a specified range of the data buffer.

methods.name: void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
methods.description: Retrieves data from the buffer starting at an offset, possibly spanning multiple linked buffers.

methods.name: void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
methods.description: Sets data into the buffer starting at an offset, possibly spanning multiple linked buffers.

methods.name: uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, managing multiple linked buffers.
